mLocKeys.keySummary: Quinn dashes to an enemy, dealing physical damage and slowing the target's Move Speed. Upon reaching the target, she leaps off the target, briefly interrupting it, and lands near her maximum Attack Range away from the target.
mLocKeys.keyTooltip: Quinn dashes to an enemy, dealing <physicalDamage>@TotalDamage@ physical damage</physicalDamage> and marking them with <keywordMajor>Harrier</keywordMajor>. Quinn then leaps backwards from the target, slightly <status>Knocking</status> them <status>Back</status> and <status>Slowing</status> them by @SlowAmount*100@%, decaying over @SlowDecayTime@ seconds.

mBuff.mDescription:
HarrierEvery @f1@ seconds, Valor marks a nearby enemy as Vulnerable, revealing it for 4 seconds. Quinn's next attack on the target deals @f2@ (+@f3@) (@f4@% of her Attack Damage) physical damage.

Harrier's cooldown is reduced by Critical Strike Chance.

mLocKeys.keySummary: Valor, Quinn's Demacian eagle, periodically marks enemies with <keywordMajor>Harrier</keywordMajor>. Quinn's first basic attack against <keywordMajor>Harrier</keywordMajor> targets will deal bonus physical damage.
mLocKeys.keyTooltip: Every @f1@ seconds, Valor marks a nearby enemy with <keywordMajor>Harrier</keywordMajor>, revealing it for @RevealDuration@ seconds and causing Quinn's next Attack %i:OnHit% <OnHit>On-Hit</OnHit> against them to deal <physicalDamage>@BonusDamage@ bonus physical damage</physicalDamage>.
mLocKeys.keyTooltipExtended:
{{Spell_QuinnPassive_Tooltip}}

Cooldown is reduced by Critical Strike Chance.
Deals @BonusMonsterDmg@ bonus damage to Monsters.

mBuff.mDescription: <titleLeft>Harrier Speed</titleLeft><mainText>Attacking a target with Harrier has granted Quinn temporary Move Speed and Attack Speed.</mainText><postScriptLeft>Source: @SourceName@</postScriptLeft>

mLocKeys.keySummary: Quinn calls Valor to mark an enemy and hinder its vision before damaging all enemies in the immediate area.
mLocKeys.keyTooltip:
Quinn orders Valor to dive, making the first enemy hit with Harrier, reducing their vision radius for @VisionReductionDuration@ seconds and dealing @TotalDamage@ physical damage to all surrounding enemies.

If the first enemy struck is not a champion, it is Disarmed for @VisionReductionDuration@ seconds.

mBuff.mDescription: <titleLeft>Blinding Assault</titleLeft><mainText>Quinn has reduced this unit's vision radius and removed its shared ally vision temporarily. If the unit is not a champion, it instead is rendered unable to attack temporarily.</mainText><postScriptLeft>Source: @SourceName@</postScriptLeft>

mLocKeys.keySummary: Quinn and Valor team up to fly around at great speed.  Ending the ability casts Skystrike, which deals damage to nearby enemies and marks champions with Harrier.
mLocKeys.keyTooltip:
Quinn calls to Valor, pairing up after channeling for 2 seconds gaining @MovementSpeedMod*100@% Move Speed and allowing her to Recast this Ability. Attacking or using {{Spell_QuinnQ_Name}} or {{Spell_QuinnE_Name}} automatically Recasts this Ability.

Recast: Quinn and Valor perform an aerial maneuver, dealing @Damage@ physical damage, marking champions with Harrier, and ending this Ability.
mLocKeys.keyTooltipExtendedBelowLine: <rules>Being damaged by non-minions removes the Move Speed bonus for @SlowDuration@ seconds.</rules>

mBuff.mDescription: <titleLeft>Harrier</titleLeft><mainText>Valor has marked this target as <font color='#FFF673'>Vulnerable</font>, revealing it and increasing the damage of Quinn's next attack against it.</mainText><postScriptLeft>Source: @SourceName@</postScriptLeft>

mLocKeys.keySummary: Passively grants Quinn Attack Speed and Move Speed after she attacks a <keywordMajor>Harrier</keywordMajor> target. Activate to have Valor reveal a large area nearby.
mLocKeys.keyTooltip:
Passive: Attacking a Harrier target grants Quinn @AttackSpeedBonus*100@% Attack Speed and @MovespeedAmount*100@% Move Speed for @BuffDuration@ seconds.

Active: Valor reveals a large area nearby for @VisionDuration@ seconds.
